name: irregular_rectangle_surface_family
purpose: Add a simply connected irregular rectangular family that preserves ordinary rectangular-mesh topology.
Break lattice symmetry without introducing holes or nontrivial topology.
Provide a cleaner MISF-GMDS test family than occupied or perforated meshes.

public_api.name: irregular.rectangle.param.coords
public_api.signature: irregular.rectangle.param.coords(h, w = h, x_scale = 1, y_scale = 1, row_irregularity = 0.20, col_irregularity = 0.20, row_phase = 0.35, col_phase = 0.65, interior_warp = 0.08, shear = 0, min_step_ratio = 0.30)

public_api.name: irregular.rectangle.surface.embedding
public_api.signature: irregular.rectangle.surface.embedding(h, w = h, surface = c("flat", "saddle", "paraboloid", "ripple"), amplitude = 0.75, freq_u = 1, freq_v = 1, x_scale = 1, y_scale = 1, row_irregularity = 0.20, col_irregularity = 0.20, row_phase = 0.35, col_phase = 0.65, interior_warp = 0.08, shear = 0, min_step_ratio = 0.30)

public_api.name: irregular.rectangle.surface.graph
public_api.signature: irregular.rectangle.surface.graph(h, w = h, surface = c("flat", "saddle", "paraboloid", "ripple"), amplitude = 0.75, freq_u = 1, freq_v = 1, x_scale = 1, y_scale = 1, row_irregularity = 0.20, col_irregularity = 0.20, row_phase = 0.35, col_phase = 0.65, interior_warp = 0.08, shear = 0, min_step_ratio = 0.30, connectivity = c("orthogonal", "diagonal"), normalize = c("median", "mean", "none"))

construction_rules.axis_irregularity: Perturb positive horizontal and vertical interval weights deterministically, clip by min_step_ratio, then renormalize cumulative sums to keep boundary endpoints fixed.
construction_rules.interior_warp: Apply a smooth warp multiplied by a boundary-vanishing envelope so the boundary remains rectangular.
construction_rules.surface_lift: Reuse flat/saddle/paraboloid/ripple lifts after the irregular planar coordinates are built.
construction_rules.edge_weights: Use induced Euclidean edge lengths with the existing normalization helper.

recommended_benchmarks: regular flat rectangle vs irregular flat rectangle
regular paraboloid rectangle vs irregular paraboloid rectangle
cmdscale -> GMDS vs MISF-GMDS on both regular and irregular rectangles
non_goals: Do not introduce holes, slits, or disconnected occupancy masks.
Do not add a separate square-only API.
